::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Krisemi Design Technologies, Hyderabad (registered at Gowlidoddi) with a Bengaluru office and a Malaysia presence. Lists 20 IO/PHY/analog IP blocks, 19 of them silicon-proven from 130nm to 10nm, alongside design services and a GAGAN receiver board.
:::

## What does this firm design?

IO, PHY, SerDes, PLL and analog IP blocks; ASIC design services; GAGAN/GNSS receiver products.
